title: GTP, GTPv2: use wmem_maps instead of GHashTables
description:
Use `wmem_map_t`s (with `wmem_file_scope()`) instead of `GHashTable`s in
`packet-gtp.c` and `packet-gtpv2.c`. This stops us from mixing wmem and
GLib memory allocations in these dissectors.

Changes pass the test suite, and produce identical results from `tshark -2nVr` against [this file](https://www.cloudshark.org/captures/d9353f10683c) (found via simple web search) as without the change.
